title: Conditional reassociation
contract: Under integer addition, left and right reassociation agree; subtraction is a negative assumption control.
scope: Triples over 0..2; operation add/sub; admission add.
assumptions: Only admitted inputs within the finite model; outside-assumption probes are recorded separately and are not contract failures.

obligations.claim: The two groupings agree for the specified operation.
Candidate regrouped result equals original left grouping.

variants.description: Use left grouping on admitted inputs; evaluate right grouping outside profile.
